title: Refined uniqueness results for 2D Euler and gSQG with rough Kraichnan noise
summary: We prove strong well-posedness results for the stochastic 2D Euler equations in vorticity form and generalized SQG equations, with $L^p$ initial data and driven by a spatially rough, incompressible transport noise of Kraichnan type. Previous works addressed this problem with noise of spatial regularity $α\in (0,1/2)$, in a setting where a rougher noise yields a stronger regularization. We remove this limitation by allowing any $α\in (0,1)$, covering the same range of parameters for which anomalous regularization effects are known to occur in passive scalars.
